sum: Forestar Group Inc. operates as a residential lot development company in the United States. It acquires land and develops finished residential lots for single-family residential homes. The company sells its residential single-family finished lots to local, regional, and national homebuilders. It also leases office space. Forestar Group Inc. was incorporated in 2005 and is headquartered in Arlington, Texas. Forestar Group Inc. operates as a subsidiary of D.R. Horton, Inc.
ceo: Mr. Anthony W. Oxley (President, CEO & Executive Chairman)
